claim.text: And last year the murder rate saw its single largest decline in recorded history.
claim.context: The flow of deadly fentanyl across our border is down by a record 56 percent in one year. || And last year the murder rate saw its single largest decline in recorded history. || This is the biggest decline, think of it, in recorded history—the lowest number in over 125 years.

row.reasoning: available 2025 data showed a large preliminary decline, but the record-setting national claim was only a projection and AP reported FBI confirmation was not yet available as of the utterance

evidence.snippet: [2026-01-29] Near-primary CCJ year-end data: homicide down 21% in 2025, likely lowest ever once FBI reports nationwide figures.
[2026-01-01] CCJ Jan 2026: 35‑city homicides down 21%; projects ~4.0/100k and says it could be largest single‑year drop since 1900.
[2025-08-05] FBI official release: 2024 murder/non-negligent manslaughter fell 14.9%, the largest one-year national homicide decline on record.
[2025-06-09] FBI official quarterly UCR data documenting the steep 2024 murder decline underpinning the record-drop claim.
[2026-01-22] CBS News coverage of the CCJ study: ‘‘Murders plummeted more than 20%’’ and calls it the single‑largest one‑year drop in the study’s data.
[2026-02-24] AP Fact Focus cautions the White House claim is premature — CCJ projects a possibility but nationwide FBI confirmation was not yet available.
[2025-08-05] Established outlet: FBI 2024 report shows crime down in every category, homicides down ~15% year over year.
White House cites CCJ: murder rate plummeted to lowest since 1900, biggest one-year drop in recorded history.
